fact: The Act came into force on 25 June 2024 by SI 35 of 2024, Regulations SI 56 of 2025 were gazetted on 29 August 2025, and the Human Rights Commission gazetted Guidelines on 5 December 2025 and will enforce penalties from 25 June 2026.
title: Guidance to information holders on progressive compliance with the Access to Information Act
